parameters.query:
WITH EmaLogs AS (
  SELECT status AS current_status, timestamp AS current_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" WHERE device = 'Weather_Station_ZONA_A'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
ActLogs AS (
  SELECT status AS current_status, timestamp AS current_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" WHERE device = 'Actuator_Controller'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
LastEmaAlert AS (
  SELECT description, "createdAt"
  FROM "Notification"
  WHERE type = 'NODE_ALERT'
  ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT current_status FROM EmaLogs) AS ema_current_status,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT current_timestamp FROM EmaLogs)))::integer AS ema_current_seconds,
  (SELECT current_status FROM ActLogs) AS act_current_status,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT current_timestamp FROM ActLogs)))::integer AS act_current_seconds,
  (SELECT description FROM LastEmaAlert) AS last_alert_description,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT "createdAt" FROM LastEmaAlert)))::integer AS last_alert_seconds;

=INSERT INTO "Notification" (id, type, title, description, status, priority, "createdAt", "updatedAt")
VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'NODE_ALERT'::"NotificationType", 'Alerta de Nodo EMA', '{{ $json.notifDescription }}', 'READ'::"NotificationStatus", 'HIGH'::"NotificationPriority", NOW(), NOW());
